title: Bazaar bhulda nahi
body:
Bazaar bhulda nahi
Pichanve hijri e Madina Mohammed dae veda Zehra dae
Veda Zehra dae mayyat Sajjad mazlum di
Jedevele mera panjwa Imam babe ko kafan pawayaye bhena de vain badh gayin hakal mar ki ahdiyain
Veeran......
Babe ko kafan ke rang do pawayaye
Imam roke farmain dain mediya bhena me babe ku jeda kafan pawayaee udar rang sufed ahi
Jedevele farmayee rang sufed ahi u vele bhena vain karke ahdiyain
Jase safed pawayaee ta kafan bhi mu wali jada rang suf kyu ahi
Bhena de vain sunke Imam Mohammed Baqir babe di mayyat de qareeb aaye
Babe di kafan de band kholen
Imam di nazar mayyat da babe di akkha bande hen ta akkha vicho vi radd jari ahi
U vele Imam Mohammed Baqir babe di peshani ko bosa deke Ahden
Baba.....
Mayyat kahi ke radd na ro mat akhiya mar hunjli
Mere Imam Sajjad di mayyat de vichua va agayhin
Baqar........
Bachda meko bazar naen bhulda
Oo meko bazar naen bhulda
Tu jo ahden kafan de vich na ro meku Baqar bazaar bhulda naen....x2
Ma wa phuphiyan de bheed vich turdha...x2
Medi akhiyan hago jo hatda nahi
<<MINI>>
Tu jo ahden kafan......x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Jeeve burqe ummat ne lute di raen
Raksh thi qaid mede akhiyan di)x2
Judvi mava ka sar jhula diste....x2
Sir pe burqa meko nazar da naen
<<MINI>>
Tu jo aden kafan....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Judvi apne hathau te diste
Lasha kamda hoya Sakina da)...x2
Mede konoi qaidi mayyat da....x2
Bhaar achdoni bachda chauda naen
<<MINI>>
Tu jo aden kafan....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Aye jo mayku kafan di the bachda
Yaad aden bekafan lashein)x2
Mede safraale vich jhade kitna....x2
Koi janaza jo meko bhulda naen
<<MINI>>
Tu jo aden kafan...x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Medhi gurbat Shahan kya likhsi
Sadhi mazloomiyat di had koi naen
